pyqgis_plugin.name: Fillet & Chamfer for QGIS 3.x (Interactive & Batch)
pyqgis_plugin.description: Interactive Fillet, Chamfer, Two-Line Merge, Corner Restoration, CAD Rotation, Mirror, Scale, Edge Offset, Feature Array, Ortho Angles & Explode Line suite for QGIS.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Comprehensive CAD editing suite providing interactive Fillet (corner rounding), Chamfer (corner beveling), Two-Line Fillet/Chamfer (Line Merge), Two-Edge Corner Restoration (Unfillet / Unchamfer), Interactive CAD Rotation, CAD Mirror Tool, CAD 3-Point Scale with Rotation Tool, CAD Edge Offset (Parallel Shift) Tool, CAD Feature Array along a line tool, CAD Polar (Circular) Array Tool, CAD Divide / Measure Line Tool, CAD Ortho Angles (orthogonalization of polygon/building corners relative to a reference facade), and CAD Explode Line Tool for QGIS, along with an instant batch fillet and chamfer dock panel for selected vector features across QGIS 3.x and QGIS 4.x.
pyqgis_plugin.tags: cad, editing, fillet, chamfer, unfillet, corner, restore, rotate, rotation, mirror, symmetry, scale, scale-rotate, offset, edge-offset, array, feature-array, polar-array, circular-array, divide, measure, line-division, explode, ortho, orthogonal, orthogonalize, building, squaring, facade, duplicate, nodes, clean, deduplicate, self-intersection, topology, geometry, digitizing, curve, batch, merge, qgis4
pyqgis_plugin.change_log: 1.0.0.87: - Updated plugin resources. 1.0.0.86: - Fixed CAD Divide Line hover crashes by using the existing CRS-aware segment snapping API instead of a missing helper method. - Added a regression test for Divide Line canvas mouse-move selection. 1.0.0.85: - Made Two-Line Fillet/Chamfer multipart-aware and atomic, preserving all unselected parts and delaying feature deletion until the merged geometry is accepted. - Preserved finite Z/M/ZM ordinates across topology operations and added safe native-curve preservation or explicit rejection according to each tool's curve policy. - Unified canvas-CRS preview and commit for Rotate, Scale & Rotate, Polar Array, and Ortho Angles; fixed hidden HUD Escape routing and QGIS 4 mapToolSet cleanup. - Added checked edit transactions, cross-version regressions, explicit runtime packaging, accurate smoke-runner reporting, and release documentation. 1.0.0.84: - Fixed Escape key step-back and tool deactivation in CAD Ortho Angles and CAD Polar Array by unifying event filtering across canvas, HUD panel, spinboxes, and line edits, and ensuring robust integer key code handling and clean Pan tool activation upon tool exit. 1.0.0.83: - Fixed batch fillet/chamfer NameError by adding missing GeometryEngine import to package try block in plugin.py. - Updated CAD Ortho Angles and CAD Polar Array click selection to visually highlight chosen features via dedicated rubberbands instead of modifying layer selection state. 1.0.0.81: - Fixed NameError in initGui by adding missing relative imports for OrthoAnglesCanvasWidget and CADOrthoAnglesMapTool when running as installed QGIS plugin package. 1.0.0.80: - Added CAD Ortho Angles tool: interactive orthogonalization of building footprints and polygon/polyline corners (90° right angles) relative to a clicked reference facade/wall edge. - Features floating HUD canvas panel with angle tolerance spinbox (1°-45°), tolerance lock button, presets/history menu, preserve area toggle (centroid-based scaling), create copy toggle, and vertex displacement marker visualization. 1.0.0.79: - Fixed guide line gap and angle desynchronization when rotating past 360° and reversing direction. Unified radius ray with arc angle so visual guides and feature copies are 100% synchronized in both CW and CCW directions. 1.0.0.78: - Implemented 4-step CAD workflow for Polar Array: Select Feature(s) -> Set Center -> Specify 0° Baseline Direction -> Rotate Array with seamless real-time angle synchronization and full-circle sweep. 1.0.0.77: - Added 0° baseline reference ray (indigo dashed line) to CAD Polar Array preview. - Clamped angle accumulation strictly to [-360°, +360°] with subtle 360° magnetic snap to prevent over-winding and eliminate 355° jump. 1.0.0.76: - Added lock and preset/history menu buttons to both Step Angle and Fill Angle rows on the CAD Polar Array HUD panel. - Implemented step-back and clean tool deactivation for the Escape key and right-click across all CAD Polar Array states. 1.0.0.75: - Enhanced CAD Polar Array tool: 3-step workflow (Select Feature -> Center Point -> Angle/Confirm), distinct individual rubberbands for each copy, amber cross center marker, fill angle lock button, and step angle presets & recent values popup menu. 1.0.0.74: - Fixed rotation angle tracking across CAD Rotate, Scale & Rotate, and Polar Array tools to prevent guide line flip and allow smooth continuous rotation past 180° up to 360°. 1.0.0.73: - Added CAD Divide / Measure Line tool (CADDivideLineMapTool) with floating top-right HUD panel, interactive segment preview, alternating segment coloring, equal parts count vs fixed step length, reverse direction, and single vs multipart output. - Updated HUD canvas panel styling and top-right pinned placement for Polar Array and Divide Line tools. 1.0.0.72: - Added CAD Polar (Circular) Feature Array tool (CADPolarArrayMapTool) with floating HUD panel, interactive rubberband preview, snapping, angle step/fill angle control, and feature rotation. 1.0.0.71: - Restored standard QGIS theme appearance for "Explode selected lines" push button in HUD canvas widget. 1.0.0.69: - Added single-segment (2-point line) explosion prevention with messageBar strip notifications for click and batch modes in ExplodeLineMapTool. 1.0.0.68: - Initial release of Fillet & Chamfer Tool for QGIS.
